class: A brief that says 'failing test first' is read as a wish: the builder writes the code, then a test that already passes, so the test has never been seen to fail.
mechanism: A sentence in a brief is not an order of events.

first_seen.evidence: Builders wrote tests after the code; fixed by demanding two commits in order (test first, red; then code).

fix: Briefs demand two commits in order.

detection.note: A prose rule; nothing checks commit order. Touches no spec section (process class).
